about: 2026-11-21 lumberjack2: SELECT -- F2 LUMBERJACK MATCH > PICKED = SELECT, LUMBERJACKS 6: through Regular's own menus (qa_reg 13 + 16384) the Lumberjack Match row, then on the Superstar Select the two competitors (Austin for the player, The Rock for the CPU) and then the six lumberjacks, each picked on the select as a player picks (controller 1): Edge, Jeff Hardy, Matt Hardy, Trish Stratus (qa_lj_w1..4), then two more boxes; a woman is allowed when picked. The game's own rivals (each moveset's Rival 1-3: Jeff and Matt Hardy name Edge, Christian and Trish) make brawls among them possible -- QA: one every 10 s window with nobody out (qa_lj_brawl 101); never between non-rivals. The CPU plays the player from 20 s. (lumberjack3: the brawls play their moves but do no damage -- the damage put back; the picks read from lj_j / lj_k; the match's end and the menus after it are lumberjack_menu's to show: a CPU-vs-CPU match here outlasted 2400 s.)
